_comment: WorkBuddy 打包时注入 SKILL.md frontmatter 的字段（官方必填 description_zh / description_en / version / author）。源 skills/ 不加这些字段，避免影响其它客户端。author 应与入驻主体名称一致，入驻后核对。
author: Scrumball

scrumball-connect.description_zh: Scrumball 连接器的登录授权与问题排查。
scrumball-connect.description_en: Sign-in and troubleshooting for the Scrumball connector.

scrumball-creators.description_zh: 按领域、国家、粉丝量搜索 YouTube / Instagram / TikTok 网红，查看数据、近期作品与已解锁的受众画像，存入收藏夹，经同意后解锁联系邮箱。
scrumball-creators.description_en: Search YouTube, Instagram and TikTok creators, review stats, recent posts and unlocked audience insights, save to collections and, with your OK, unlock contact emails.

scrumball-outreach.description_zh: 查看建联任务、建联数据看板和与网红的往来邮件，找出待回复、已报价和久未跟进的会话。只读。
scrumball-outreach.description_en: Read outreach tasks, the outreach dashboard and email threads with creators; find replies to handle, quotes and stalled threads. Read-only.

scrumball-stats.description_zh: 按成员或全公司查看解锁、收藏、建联、发信与回复数据，排行、趋势、消费与剩余额度。
scrumball-stats.description_en: Usage per member or company-wide: unlocks, saves, outreach, emails sent and replied, rankings, trends, spending and remaining credits.

scrumball-tracking.description_zh: 查看推广成效报告与贴文发布追踪。
scrumball-tracking.description_en: Review campaign performance reports and post tracking.

scrumball-resources.description_zh: 查看网红资源记录；经授权可编辑标签、备注、状态和自定义字段。
scrumball-resources.description_en: Review creator resources and, with permission, edit tags, remarks, status and custom fields.

scrumball-campaigns.description_zh: 查看推广活动与网红合作记录。
scrumball-campaigns.description_en: Review promotion campaigns and creator collaborations.

scrumball-approvals.description_zh: 查看推广活动审批单、审批人和流程。
scrumball-approvals.description_en: Review promotion approvals, approvers and flows.

entry.name: scrumball-influencer-marketing
entry.description_zh: 用 Scrumball 网红营销平台找网红、跟进建联和网红回信、看团队数据与推广成效，查看资源库、推广活动与审批。首次使用会引导你安装 Scrumball 连接器。
entry.description_en: Use Scrumball to find creators, follow outreach and creator emails, review team usage and performance, and look up resources, campaigns and approvals. Guides you to install the Scrumball connector first.
